UnitStatement: PreviewModel.Vec3 is a 3D vector type with numeric x, y, z fields.
PreviewModel is the desktop preview document model carrying schema_version, document_kind, data_boundary, project, analysis_status, model entities, and diagnostics.
PreviewModel.project carries id, name, description, and a units map.
PreviewModel.analysis_status reports mechanics, rule_check, and professional_acceptance status strings.
PreviewModel.materials entries carry id, label, elastic_modulus, shear_modulus, optional thermal_expansion_coefficient (each a value/unit pair), and provenance.
PreviewModel.sections entries carry id, name, section_type (pipe|rigid|custom|TBD|string), a properties map of value/unit pairs (e.g. outside_diameter, wall_thickness), and provenance.
PreviewModel.nodes entries carry id, label, position (Vec3), and provenance.
PreviewModel.pipe_segments entries carry id, label, from, to, section value/unit map, material, optional y_reference (Vec3), and provenance.
PreviewModel.supports entries carry id, label, node, a restraints string list, and provenance.
PreviewModel.components entries carry id, label, kind, node, and provenance.
PreviewModel.load_cases entries carry id, label, kind, status, provenance, and optional primitive_loads.
PreviewModel.combinations entries carry id, label, a basis string, terms (load_case + factor), optional minuend_id/subtrahend_id/operand_ids/mode, and provenance.
Combination.basis is a closed basis set mirroring core load_case_algebra vocabulary: mechanics, result_state_subtraction, or range_envelope.
Diagnostic carries optional id, a code, a severity (info|warning|error|blocking), a message, optional source, and optional affected_refs.
KnowledgeRecord carries id, kind, title, summary, affected_refs, provenance, and status.
DesignKnowledge carries schema_version, document_kind, knowledge_set_id, model_ref, a records list, and diagnostics.
MechanicsResult carries schema_version, document_kind, run_id, model_ref, status, summary, a results list, and diagnostics.
MechanicsResult.summary may include max_displacement and max_open_formula_stress, each a value/unit with location_ref and result_ref or null.

MechanicsResult.results entries carry id, kind, value, unit, entity_ref, optional basis_ref, optional source_result_refs, and optional metadata (component, coordinate_system, location, basis, sign_convention).
ResultBasisRef carries a ref_type (load_case|combination|string) and a ref_id.
SelectedReviewTarget is a discriminated union over target_type result, diagnostic, or model_entity, each with an id.

ResultInterpretation describes a result's family, entity_ref, value_label, component, coordinate_system, location, recovery_basis, sign_convention, source_result_refs, linked diagnostics and knowledge, source_run metadata, optional endpoint_pair, and professional_boundary.
ResultInterpretation.source_run records run_id, model_ref, audit_ref, result_hash_count, and envelope_hash_available.
ResultInterpretation.endpoint_pair pairs two endpoint values sharing entity_ref/component/coordinate_system/recovery_basis, each with result_id, location, value_label, and sign_convention.
DiagnosticInterpretation describes a diagnostic's code, severity, source, message, affected_refs, linked_results, linked_knowledge, review_explanation, and professional_boundary.
MechanicsGap carries id, capability, status (implemented|deferred|not_implemented|requires_private_inputs), and a review_note.
ObjectRef carries an object_type and a ref string.
AnalysisRunEnvelope is the DEL-14-02 / PKG-14 analysis run record carrying schema_version, scope_item, objectives, run_contract_status, and an analysis_run block.

AnalysisRunEnvelope.analysis_run carries run_id, run_name, run_kind, model_state_ref, load_basis_refs, result_refs, hashes, analysis_status, reproducibility, immutability_policy, and professional_boundary.
analysis_run.result_refs entries carry result_ref, result_family, hash_refs, and privacy_classification.
analysis_run hash_refs use algorithm sha256 with a canonicalization, payload_ref, payload_scope, and value.
analysis_run.reproducibility carries input_manifest_refs, determinism_notes, and unresolved_tbd.
analysis_run.immutability_policy declares run_record_is_read_only, mutation_policy, new_run_required_for_change, and hash_invalidates_external_acceptance.
SolveJobEvent carries event_id, a state (not_started|queued|running|cancelling|cancelled|completed|failed), message, result_available, diagnostic_count, result_row_count, and analysis_status.
SolveJobAuditState audits a solve job's job_id, state, progress_basis, backend seam, cancellation status, backend job id/token, events, and error_message.
SolveJobAuditState declares percentages_synthesized false and backend_percent_stream_available false (no synthesized progress percentages).
SolveJobBackendSeam is one of tauri_backend_job, browser_fixture_no_backend_job, no_job_started, or restored_persisted_run_no_new_solve.
PreviewComparison (document_kind openpipestress.technical_preview.comparison, DEL-14-04 / PKG-14) is a single_run_load_basis_review comparing a left and right participant.
PreviewComparison.summary reports comparable_result_pairs, unmatched left/right results, mapping_basis, tolerance_status not_tolerance_checked, and tolerance_profile_ref TBD.
ComparisonParticipant carries label, basis_ref, model_state_ref, analysis_run_ref, and result_count.

ComparisonDelta carries mapping_id, left/right result ids, entity_ref, result_family, component, location, unit, left/right values, raw_delta, absolute_delta, classification not_tolerance_checked, and classification_basis.
AgentProposal carries schema_version, document_kind, proposal_id, prompt, an operation block, rationale, assumptions, validation, audit_boundary, and professional_boundary.
AgentProposal.operation carries operation_id, operation_kind, operation_status, affected_entity_ids, and changes (change_id, change_kind, target_ref, before, after).
AgentProposal.audit_boundary declares requires_user_acceptance, mutates_accepted_model_state, and acceptance_recorded_as_review_only.
EditorOperationObjectType enumerates Material, Section, Node, Element, Component, Support, Load, and Combination.
EditorOperationSource carries source_ref, source_channel (e.g. local_desktop_preview), and source_role (e.g. gui_editor, viewport_editor).

EditorOperationIntent represents a proposed user editor operation with optional queue_id, operation_id, operation_kind (create|connect|delete|insert|modify), operation_status proposed, author_type user, optional source, target, change, validation, audit_boundary, professional_boundary, and rationale.

EditorOperationIntent.change.change_kind enumerates the structured edit kinds: set_field, update_load, update_support, create/delete node, connect/delete pipe_run, create section/material/support/load_case, delete load_case, create/delete primitive_load, create/delete combination, create/delete combination_term, delete support, and insert_component_symbol.
EditorOperationIntent.validation initializes schema/constraint/unit validation as not_run, diff_preview_status not_generated, and application_status not_applied.
EditorOperationIntent.audit_boundary declares mutation_route structured_operations_only, direct_model_mutation_allowed false, requires_user_acceptance true, and mutates_accepted_model_state false.
EditorOperationIntent.professional_boundary asserts human_review_required true and that software makes no compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or authentication claim.
OperationOutcomeDiagnostic carries id, code, severity (blocking|warning|info|string), message, remediation, affected_refs, and source.
OperationDiffPreviewRow carries entity_ref, object_type, field_path, before, after, unit, dimension, and change_kind.
OperationValidationStates carries schema, reference, unit, and before_state validation states plus diff_preview_status and application_status.
OperationModelBasisEvidence carries claimed_model_hash, claimed_hash_canonicalization, backend_model_hash, backend_canonicalization, and binding_status.
OperationAcceptanceRecord carries acceptance_basis, acceptance_is_professional_approval, and persistence_status.

OperationOutcome records an operation's mode (validate_only|apply), application_route (tauri_backend_apply|local_wasm_engine), identifiers, validation, diff_preview, diagnostics, model_basis, input_model_unchanged, applied_model, applied_model_backend_hash, acceptance, audit_boundary, and professional_boundary.

AppliedOperationReceipt records receipt_id, sequence, operation/change ids, target object_type and ref, field_path, before, after, application_route, applied_model_hash, acceptance, diagnostics, and professional_boundary.
EntityRef carries an id and a type drawn from project, material, section, node, pipe, support, component, load, combination, or diagnostic.

LocalStorageCapability describes the local store: engine (e.g. SQLite), bundled, fts5_available, network_required, daemon_required, telemetry_enabled, path/large_file policies, database_path, compile_options, migration_framework/status, schema versions, and migrations_applied_on_open.

LocalProjectSummary summarizes a local project's id/name, database_path, storage_mode, migration status/framework, schema versions, fts_indexed, copied_external_files, and counts/refs for editor intents, proposals, review targets, mechanics results, analysis runs, and model/envelope hashes, plus unit_round_trip status/signature.
LocalProjectIndexEntry carries project_id, project_name, storage_mode (local_sqlite|browser_memory_preview|string), created_at_unix, and updated_at_unix.
ModelHashEvidence records a model hash using algorithm sha256, canonicalization rfc8785_jcs, payload_scope model_payload, payload_ref, value, and hash_status computed_local_preview.

ModelHashIntegrityEvidence reports integrity_status (verified_match|mismatch_review_required|not_persisted|hash_recompute_unavailable), persisted and recomputed values, payload_ref, and verification_basis recomputed_on_open_from_restored_model.
ProjectEnvelopeHashEvidence records the project envelope hash (sha256, rfc8785_jcs) over payload_scope project_envelope_payload excluding storage_summary_and_envelope_hash_carrier_fields.
ProjectEnvelopeHashIntegrityEvidence reports envelope hash integrity_status, persisted/recomputed values, payload_ref, and verification_basis recomputed_on_open_from_restored_envelope_payload.
PackageHashEvidence records a package_review_payload hash (sha256, rfc8785_jcs) excluding validation-report/manifest package-hash carrier fields.

ModelDocumentMigrationStatus reports status (current|migrated|newer_than_supported|unsupported_schema|failed), source/target schema versions, migration_framework, db and product schema migration statuses, applied_migration_ids, persistence_state, and detail.

ModelMigrationLedgerRecord records a migration event with record_kind, recorded_at_unix, source/target schema versions, applied_migration_ids, migration_framework, pre/post migration model hashes, trigger, destructive_rewrite flag, and professional_boundary.

LocalProjectEnvelope aggregates summary, model, editor_intents, proposal, selected_review_target, mechanics_result, analysis_run, model_hash, project_envelope_hash, model_document_migration, and model_migration_ledger.

Build-time guard TP-APP-R2-WASMPKG-001: the wasm operation engine is the sole browser-mode engine (DEC-020 / ADR-0001), so a production bundle missing public/wasm-engine/ assets is broken by construction and must fail the build loudly.
The required wasm engine asset filenames are open_pipe_stress_operation_applier.js and open_pipe_stress_operation_applier_bg.wasm.
missingWasmEngineAssets(dir) returns the wasm engine asset filenames absent from dir/wasm-engine/.

wasmEngineGuardError raises a WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT error naming the missing assets and instructing to build with `npm run build:wasm --workspace apps/desktop` and rebuild, since no fallback engine exists.
wasmEngineDistGuard is a build-only Vite plugin that checks public/wasm-engine/ at buildStart and dist/wasm-engine/ at closeBundle, throwing if assets are missing.
The Vite config registers the react() plugin and wasmEngineDistGuard plugin and sets clearScreen false.
The dev server runs on port 5173 with strictPort false.
manualChunks splits node_modules into vendor chunks: vendor-three (three), vendor-react (react/react-dom), vendor-icons (lucide-react), vendor-tauri (@tauri-apps), and a default vendor chunk.
The Vitest config uses the jsdom environment, globals, includes src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}, and the ./src/test/setup.ts setup file.
Vitest test and hook timeouts are raised to 30000ms because the full <App /> renders flake at the default 5s timeout under load; a genuine 30s+ render indicates a real defect.
